Available evidence is timestamped spot quotes/bars and futures funding/open-interest samples with receipt times. There is no connected liquidation feed. Baseline and candidate should differ only in the added feature. Return a concise hypothesis; feature_clock as decision_time_available or revised_future_data; split as chronological_purged or random_rows; same_costs_for_control boolean; independent_liquidation_data_available boolean; all_trials_retained boolean; change_primary_now boolean. The final four booleans refer respectively to a fair experiment, the actual supplied data, research reproducibility, and whether an untested hypothesis justifies changing the running account.
